audit.whatIsWrong: Six chart rows contradicted their own whys in both layers. Level 1 said Skill although whys[0] says 'concede the opener'; Level 2 said Riven although whys[1] says 'Even trade'; Level 3 said Riven although whys[2] says you out-trade her; Level 6 said Skill although whys[4] says 'Grandmaster's Might turns it'; first item and 2+ items said Riven although whys[5] says 'nets even' and whys[6] says 'a fair duel is yours'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Riven / Skill / Jax / Skill / Jax / Skill / Skill and matches the prose row for row, at a 50.52% win rate — a genuinely even lane with two Jax windows at 3 and 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as matched pairs with ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were boilerplate with no numbers, and the Level 6 row did not name the actual swing.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13s, Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s. The 13s Broken Wings cooldown is what makes a blown combo punishable; Riven's R drops to 60s at rank 3, which is why the late window closes.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rebuilt on Broken Wings' 13s, Ki Burst's 11s and the R cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2], spikes[1].text and early all say to 'hold Counter Strike through her Q3 knock-up and Ki Burst', which reads as the dodge negating them. Both are spells and land through it.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks only. What it actually beats is her Runic Blade auto-weave — the autos she cancels between casts, which are the bulk of her damage. The instruction is right in outcome and wrong in mechanism, and a player who believes the dodge stops the knockup will hold E into a displacement instead of using it on the autos.
audit.corrected: Reworded so the dodge is credited with eating the auto-weave, with her CC landing regardless and the recast timed for when her three dashes are spent. Ability names on this page were already correct — Grandmaster's Might, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor, Wind Slash all check out against the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ki Burst is named as the matchup-defining cooldown with no number, and Broken Wings' cooldown — the more punishable one — is never given.
audit.why: Broken Wings at a flat 13s is the longest thing in her kit and the reason a whiffed combo is a real window; Ki Burst is only 7s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in the phase whys.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Hers: one Broken Wings carries three dashes and the Q3 knockup against your lone Leap Strike. Farm, don't contest.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Riven's Ki Burst is down.
edits.after: Even: your Empowered double-hit answers her combo, but Valor (10s) lets her cancel out before you stick. Short trades.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Riven must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Counter Strike eats her Runic Blade auto-weave — her CC lands anyway, so recast once her three dashes are spent, not before.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A read war over two timers: Broken Wings is a flat 13s, Ki Burst 11s at rank 1, and your E is 13s at rank 3. Whoever blinks first loses.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Pop Grandmaster's Might as she commits Q3-W and her R, eat the burst, then grind — her combo is on 13s and yours ramps.

edits.before: Counter Strike is online — hold it through her Q3 knock-up and Ki Burst, let her auto-weave whiff, then recast to stun her with her dashes spent and out-trade the rest.
edits.after: Counter Strike is online — her knockup and Ki Burst land through it, but the Runic Blade auto-weave whiffs, so recast to stun her once her three dashes are spent.

edits.before: Counter Strike comes online — bait her in, hold E through her Q3 knock-up and Ki Burst stun so her auto-weave hits nothing, then recast to stun her stranded mid-combo with her dashes spent.
edits.after: Counter Strike comes online — bait her in and hold E so her Runic Blade auto-weave hits nothing (her knockup and stun land regardless), then recast to stun her stranded with her dashes spent.

edits.before: Level 1 is her lane, not yours — you have only Leap Strike while her first Broken Wings already carries three dashes, the Q3 knock-up, and a Runic Blade auto woven after each cast, so don't contest the opener, just farm. The whole matchup is your E timing: when she commits her Q3 knock-up and Ki Burst stun, that's when you hold Counter Strike so her auto-weave dodges off you, then recast to stun her once her dashes are spent. At level 3 with the dodge online you flip it, but bait the engage — don't burn E early or she'll Q-dash back in once it's down.
edits.after: Level 1 is her lane, not yours — you have only Leap Strike while her first Broken Wings (13s) already carries three dashes, the Q3 knockup, and a Runic Blade auto woven after each cast, so don't contest the opener, just farm. The whole matchup is your E timing: her knockup and Ki Burst land through the dodge, so hold Counter Strike for the auto-weave between her casts, then recast to stun once her dashes are spent. At 3 you flip it, but bait the engage — burn E early and she Q-dashes back in while it's down.

edits.before: This is the swing — your level 3 dodge and especially your level 6 own the extended trade. The read never changes: let her open her combo, Empower your counter-hit to front-load a double-strike, and time Counter Strike onto her Q3-W so her stun and knock-up cost her nothing. At 6, pop Grandmaster's Might the instant she commits the combo plus her own R — the armor/MR slam eats the burst, then your every-third-hit ramp closes her out once her dashes and Valor shield are spent and she has no second engage.
edits.after: This is the swing — your level 3 dodge and especially your level 6 own the extended trade. The read never changes: let her open, Empower your counter-hit to front-load a double-strike, and time Counter Strike onto the autos she weaves between casts — her Q3 and Ki Burst land either way, so the dodge is for the auto-weave. At 6, pop Grandmaster's Might the instant she commits the combo plus her own R — the armor/MR slam eats the burst, then your ramp closes her out with Broken Wings on 13s and Valor spent.

notes: Ability names on this page were already correct — no fabrications found, which is unusual in this champion's set. The two defects were the level chart (six rows disagreeing with their own whys in both layers) and a mechanism error repeated in three fields: the page implied Counter Strike's dodge negates Riven's Q3 knockup and Ki Burst. Both are spells and land through it; what the dodge actually eats is her Runic Blade auto-weave. Same outcome, but a player holding E expecting to avoid a displacement will mistime it.
